text:
Zoe (Partnerships): kicking off NomadCore EAP thread. NDA executed, partner ready to ship two dev boards next week. Key items: benchmark matrix, telemetry floor, lab windows, marketplace label, and joint announcement timing. Please keep replies short.

Ethan (Eng-ML): propose matrix: batches [1,4,16], seqs [64,256,1024], models: rwd-gpt-2b, community-6b-q4. Metrics: p50/p95 latency, sustained tokens/sec, memory/GPU, and a 200-sample quality sanity. I'll own the model runs.

Rina (Infra): staging harness at gs://redwood-eap/nomadcore/harness-v3.tar.gz. Need partner's public key for bastion, and a static route to 10.10.20.0/24. Heads-up: boards ship with thermal throttle enabled; partner said firmware v2.0 will remove the cap for long runs.

Hector (Legal): partner asked for 1h telemetry granularity; we should limit to 24h aggregates and explicitly forbid storing raw prompts or request payloads. I'll upload a one-paragraph NDA amendment with exact telemetry fields.

Marta (Product): marketplace copy draft in drive: https://drive.redwood/nomadcore-marketplace-draft. Question: "NomadCore-Optimized" badge vs "NomadCore-Validated". Marketing likes Optimized; legal may prefer Validated. Also, partner requests co-branded logo in listing.

Ethan (Eng-ML): small run snippet we'll use for steadystate; drop into CI ticket.

```bash
# warmup + steady-state run
python run_perf.py --model rwd-gpt-2b --seq 1024 --batch 4 --warmup 300 --iters 1500 --loggs gs://redwood-eap/nomadcore/results/
```

Rina (Infra): I'll provision the bastion rule and upload our deploy key. Tentative lab slots: Mon/Wed next week 0900-1500 PT. If firmware update needed, keep Friday open.

hector (Legal): uploaded NDA amendment snippet: "Telemetry fields allowed: aggregated tokens/sec, perf counters, GPU temp; no raw request payloads or user identifiers." Please review.

ci-bot: Perf job created: run-nomad-112 (owner: Rina). Link: https://ci.redwood/runs/run-nomad-112

Zoe (Partnerships): owners recap: Ethan (model runs + prompts), Rina (infra + lab), Hector (legal redline), Marta (marketplace + comms). Timeline: baseline runs by +6 days, firmware test +8 days, legal finalize in 48h, marketplace copy freeze in 10 days. Aim for joint announcement ~2 weeks after successful baseline. React with :white_check_mark: to confirm.

Ethan (Eng-ML): :white_check_mark: I'll push prompt set to drive and start runs Thu morning.

Rina (Infra): :white_check_mark: provisioning bastion and booking Mon slot.

Hector (Legal): :white_check_mark: will finalize amendment and email partner counsel.

Marta (Product): :white_check_mark: looping in comms and design for co-brand assets.

Zoe (Partnerships): thanks all. If partner asks for hourly telemetry (again), we will decline and offer a higher-resolution dashboard view instead of raw exports. Keeping thread as audit.
